source: Modern systems respond with grouped GEMMs, block-sparse kernels, topology-aware routing, fused dispatch, and computation/communication overlap. ZXNAME0000XZ, for example, explicitly co-designs routing with cross-node communication and limits the number of nodes a token can contact.
zh: 现代系统通过分组 GEMM、块稀疏内核、拓扑感知路由、融合调度和计算/通信重叠来响应。例如，ZXNAME0000XZ 明确地共同设计了跨节点通信的路由，并限制了令牌可以联系的节点数量。
